newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index edges up again.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index edges up again.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index again moved slightly higher last week with a small gain of 53.6 points or 1.67 percent. The All Ordinaries Index rose 0.44 percent.
May 16 May 9 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index again moved slightly higher last week and gains just outnumbered falls.
Continuing activity in situation stocks dominated trading, whilst others remained subdued, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.

Best performances included Spinifex Gold NL which rose six cents to 32.5 cents ahead of drilling on its Philippine prospect and Gindalbie Gold NL which rose 4.5 cents to 29 cents as it approached its first gold pour from the Two Boys mine near Higginsville, Western Australia.
Anzoil NL moved 1.4 cents higher to 7.9 cents as it prepared to further test a Vietnam well and Egerton Gold NL rose three cents to 18 cents.

Falls included Uranium Australia NL, off 2.5 cents to 17 cents, giving back some of last week's gains, Jubilee Gold Mines NL, down 1.5 cents to 16 cents, and Menzies Gold NL, down three cents to 42 cents.
